intro: Welcome to our sports facility booking platform. We are committed to protecting your personal data and respecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our mobile application and website.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
paragraphs: Because access is restricted to approved members of our educational institution compound, we collect specific details to verify your identity and manage bookings:

subsections.title: Personal Identification Information
subsections.text: Name, email address, phone number, and residential address.

subsections.title: Usage & Booking Data
subsections.text: Sports facility reserved, date/time slots, booking history, and check-in status.

subsections.title: Device & Technical Data
subsections.text: IP address, device ID, app usage statistics, and operating system version.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
paragraphs: We use the collected information for the following core operational purposes:
list: To verify your address and grant access to the app.
To process, confirm, and manage your facility bookings.
To enforce compound safety, discipline, and facility usage guidelines.
To send booking confirmations, updates, or administrative alerts via SMS, Email, or In-App notifications.

sections.title: 3. Data Sharing and Disclosure
paragraphs: We do not share your personal information. We may share data only under the following conditions:

subsections.title: Institutional Authorities
subsections.text: Booking records and user details may be shared with campus security or administration for safety, maintenance, or disciplinary compliance.

subsections.title: Service Providers
subsections.text: Third-party vendors (e.g., cloud hosting or SMS gateway providers) who assist in running the platform under strict confidentiality agreements.

subsections.title: Legal Compliance
subsections.text: When required by applicable Indian laws or legal proceedings.

sections.title: 4. Data Security & Retention
paragraphs: We implement standard technical and organizational security measures to protect your data from unauthorized access or breach. We retain your personal data for as long as you maintain an active approved account with the institution.
